verdict.rationale: Datalab is an API service, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows that API keys exist and that account security covers TOTP two-factor authentication and team-wide 2FA enforcement. Nothing documents scoped, restricted or per-agent API keys, and 2FA is a related account control, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
